caption: The video captures a wide, smoke-hazed landscape of a recently burned field beneath a pale pink sky. Blackened ground fills the foreground, studded with thin dead saplings, while taller, partly leafless trees rise across the midground and right. A low layer of white smoke hangs over the charred field and shifts subtly in density across the sequence. Small active flames already burn in two places: a bright patch at the bottom-center foreground and a longer line of fire tracing the right edge. Throughout, the right-side line of fire continues to flicker and smolder, remaining visible to the end. The bottom-center flame gradually weakens and shrinks, drifting toward the lower edge as the view slowly tightens. This tightening enlarges the central and right-side trees while pushing the foreground flame out of sight at the bottom. The pinkish sky and haze stay essentially constant in color and brightness. The scene presents an ongoing burn aftermath rather than a completed action, with fire still active on the right as the foreground patch fades from view.
relations: As the view tightens, central and right trees enlarge while the bottom-center flame drifts toward the lower edge.
The right-edge fire line persists flickering and smoldering throughout the sequence.
The foreground bottom flame gradually weakens and shrinks until pushed out of sight by the tightening view.
White smoke over the charred field shifts subtly in density while the pink sky stays constant.
